<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Document</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
</head>
<body>
    <nav>
       <center> <h1> TheSandBox Multiverse</h1></center>
    </nav>
    <section id="universe-1">
        <center>
        <div class="glass-card">
            <h2>Universe One - The First Side of the Multiverse Parallax</h2>
            <p>In the Multiverse Parallax, the first universe is a peaceful world with blue skies, green forests, and modern cities powered by clean energy. The people are curious scientists who have discovered tiny flashes in the sky that seem to come from another universe. They believe these strange sightings are caused by the Multiverse Parallax, a mysterious connection that lets them catch brief glimpses of a different world.</p>
        </center>
        </div>
    </section>
    <section id="universe-2"> <center> <div class="glass-card">
        <h2>Universe Two - The Other Side of the Multiverse Paralla-</h2>
        <p>On the other side of the Multiverse Parallax is a completely different universe with purple skies, floating islands, and glowing crystal forests. The people here have also noticed mysterious flashes showing images of another world with blue skies and tall buildings. They realise that the Multiverse Parallax is linking the two universes, allowing each world to see the other without fully crossing between them. Both universes hope to learn more about this incredible connection while keeping their worlds safe.</p>
    </div></center></section>
</body>
</html>nav{
    position: sticky;  top: 0;
}
section{
    height: 100vh; /*VH: viewport height*/
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
}
#universe-1{
  background-image:url(https://tse2.mm.bing.net/th/id/OIP.CXFOcmcaJ61v6EO6wk9cmgHaEJ?r=0&pid=ImgDet&w=203&h=113&c=7&o=7&rm=3) ;
  background-attachment: fixed; background-size: cover;
}
#universe-2{
    background-image: url(data:image/webp;base64,);
    background-attachment: fixed; background-size: cover;
}
.glass-card{
    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
    transition: 0.3s;
    border: 3cm;
    padding: 1px;;
}
